title: Quenched Molten Venezuelan Jam Empanadas
description: A garlicky and molten Venezuelan dish featuring jam and bonito flakes, perfect for a meal prep snack
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of jam in the center of each dough circle.
Sprinkle a pinch of bonito flakes and a sprinkle of garlic over the jam.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes before serving.
